Resolves #21616

Related: #21346 · #21140 · #21613

Adds `examples/scheduler/nonWorkingTime`, an eight-crew construction-site schedule across three working weeks (`2026-11-02` to `2026-11-21` UTC) holding two weekends and a second-week public holiday (`Armistice Day · Wed 11 Nov`, `nonWorkingDates: ['2026-11-11']`), backed by `Neo.data.Store` (`CrewModel`) and `Neo.timeline.store.Events` (`WorkPackageModel`). Custom-styled toolbar controls switch `showNonWorkingTime` on/off and select `Monday to Friday` (`[0, 6]`), `Monday to Saturday` (`[0]`), or `Sunday to Thursday` (`[5, 6]`), while stating explicitly: `"Shading shows the days. It does not move work."`

**Catalog record for #21613:**
- `id`: `'scheduler-non-working-time'`
- `name`: `'Weekends and holidays in the plan'`
- `feature`: `'Non-working days and dates shaded across the timeline and its header'`
- `lookFor`: `'Switch the working week to Sunday to Thursday: the shaded days move. Find the holiday in the second week.'`
- `cover`: Three weeks (`2–20 Nov`) with two shaded weekends and the shaded second-week holiday (`nonworking-1440x900-dark.jpg`).

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline + guards ran`

Evidence: L3 (Playwright E2E `NonWorkingTime.spec.mjs` in `e2e-engine` CI + headless Chromium `1440 × 900` & `390 × 844` dark/light renders and swapped-order cold-look evaluation) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-7). Residual: none for #21616; batch catalog publication lives in #21613.

## Deltas from ticket

- Fixed `timeAxis.now` outside the seeded November window (`'2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'`) so the live wall-clock `.neo-timeline-now` marker does not paint a date-dependent red line across `Fri 20 Nov` beside the rose-hatched `Wed 11 Nov` holiday band.
- Adapted `timeAxis.size` (`68 px/day` desktop, `26 px/day` `< 768px` mobile, matched to `--neo-timeline-gridline-step`) and compact segmented labels (`Mon–Fri` / `Mon–Sat` / `Sun–Thu` below `768px`) so both `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` show Weekend 1 (`7–8 Nov`) and the Week 2 holiday (`11 Nov`) on the first frame with all 8 crews unclipped.

Frame critique: Whole-surface verdict is `BETTER` on both `1440 × 900` desktop and `390 × 844` mobile. Round-1 cold-look feedback (removing `Neo.container.Base`'s default dark background behind `Working week`, unifying `Weekend` as a bordered pill matching `Armistice Day · Wed 11 Nov` with a vertical separator before `Civil / Structure / MEP`, replacing the clickable-looking sub-banner chip with plain typographic summary text, and switching `< 768px` working-week buttons to `Mon–Fri / Mon–Sat / Sun–Thu`) was resolved in-branch before commit. Remaining visible trade-offs retained by design: (1) on `390 × 844` (`26 px/day` so 10 days through `Wed 11 Nov` fit on the first mobile frame), three 3-day bars (`Crane set...`, `MEP slee...`, `Mock-up ...`) ellipsis-truncate inside `78 px` cells and `Structure · MEP` wrap cleanly beneath the legend pills while right-edge bars clip at the horizontal scroll viewport; (2) in dark mode, minor day numbers (`Sa 7`, `Su 8`, `We 11`) use engine `--neo-timeline-header-muted-color` over the hatch, kept so engine `TimeAxisHeader` tokens stay unpatched.

## Cold look

Two independent zero-context `Gemini 4 Hydrogen` readers evaluated unlabelled screenshots in swapped presentation order:
- **Reader 1 (`Sample A = basic`, `Sample B = nonWorkingTime`):** Desktop `9.5 / 10` vs `7.5 / 10` (`BETTER`); Mobile `8.5 / 10` vs `5.5 / 10` (`BETTER`). Confirmed unmistakable weekend and `Armistice Day` shading in header and rows, zero desktop bar truncation, and crisp bar readability over shaded bands in dark and light themes.
- **Reader 2 (swapped: `Sample 1 = nonWorkingTime`, `Sample 2 = basic`):** Desktop `9 / 10` vs `6 / 10` (`BETTER`); Mobile `8 / 10` vs `5 / 10` (`BETTER`). Confirmed transparent `Working week` container, unified `Weekend` / `Armistice Day` pills, balanced `Mon–Fri | Mon–Sat | Sun–Thu` mobile segments, and opaque high-contrast bars over diagonal hatching in both themes.
